what_broke: np.savez_compressed wrote straight into the Unity Catalog volume; volumes cannot seek, so each scores file failed after about 24 KB ([Errno 5] Input/output error). The per-model result JSON was written after the scores file, so it was never written. The run was cancelled during the ninth model.
results_saved: none: no result JSON, no readable scores file, for any model
detection_numbers_printed: none: the job output contains only border counts, set sizes and one FAILED line per model (saved in the repo as results/phase2/drift/cancelled-802132583124668/stdout.txt)
why_archived: these locks recorded detection looks that produced no saved or printed result; the rerun gets fresh locks with a started/completed status, and each new lock and result references this archive
